claim: A repeated query in one MCP session exposes the memory contract's seen_before field on the second result set.

args.query: On Computable Numbers with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem

notes: The task relies on a sequential pair of calls in one initialized MCP session. In a fresh install, seen_before stayed false across the measured 90-second window; cross-session continuity is demonstrated in docs/case-study.md and is not benchmarkable on a fresh install.
